publisher: Lehigh Valley Planning Commission (LV_Zoning, Lehigh County municipalities)
notes: Regional Lehigh Valley zoning layer hosted by LVPC (skharel_lvpc); covers Lehigh County municipalities, 2018 vintage (Zoning_23Mar18). zone is municipal code plus district code (e.g. 46R-3); jurisdiction is the municipality name (NAME). Zoning_District_Code is mostly empty, so ZN_MUNI_CD is used.
